players.summary: The free first episode of a story-driven adventure about Max, a photography student who discovers she can rewind time, set in a moody small coastal town.
praise: choices that feel like they matter
players.best_for: players who love slow, emotional narrative games with meaningful choices
players.not_for: anyone who needs action or challenging gameplay

games.name: Resident Evil 2

scarce ammo and tight inventory management
puzzles and exploring the interconnected police station
complaints: Leon and Claire stories don't line up
brutal extra modes and harder second runs
players.best_for: players who love tense, methodical horror with puzzles and tight resources
players.not_for: players who dislike scarce ammo, hiding and being chased

nostalgic Underground and Most Wanted feel
complaints: required EA app and account or age verification
players.best_for: players who love arcade racing, car tuning and cop chases
players.not_for: sim-racing fans or anyone who refuses EA's launcher

games.name: Project Zomboid

complaints: bugs and crashes, especially with mods
poor performance even on strong PCs
still in early access after many years
players.best_for: players who love slow, punishing survival sims and tinkering with mods

games.name: People Playground
